text: 中金公司公告称，公司换股吸收合并东兴证券、信达证券事项已获证监会批复，东兴证券、信达证券股票将于2026年10月19日起终止上市。本次A股换股实施股权登记日为2026年10月16日，东兴证券A股换股比例为1:0.4376，信达证券A股换股比例为1:0.5210。合并完成后东兴证券、信达证券将注销法人资格，其全部资产、负债等由中金公司承继，中金公司新增A股股份将申请在上交所主板上市流通。
text_en: CICC announced that its share-swap absorption merger of Dongxing Securities and Xinda Securities has received CSRC approval, and the shares of Dongxing Securities and Xinda Securities will be delisted from October 19, 2026. The record date for the implementation of this A-share share swap is October 16, 2026; the A-share swap ratio for Dongxing Securities is 1:0.4376, and the A-share swap ratio for Xinda Securities is 1:0.5210. After the merger is completed, Dongxing Securities and Xinda Securities will have their legal person status canceled, and all their assets, liabilities, and other matters will be assumed by CICC. The newly added A-shares of CICC will apply for listing and trading on the main board of the SSE.
